findings.description: The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Objects uploaded without an explicit encryption request, including reports_seed_object, may be stored without customer-managed or bucket-default encryption.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. The private ACL does not encrypt ledger export data at rest.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Versioning and access logging do not protect model artifacts from being stored unencrypted.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Its private ACL and versioning do not ensure encryption of stored runbook content.

The seed object is uploaded to reports_archive, which has no bucket default encryption, and the object does not request server-side encryption. The vendor roster may therefore be stored unencrypted at rest.
